COMPRESS::gzip
Description
Sets criteria for compressing HTTP responses.
Syntax
COMPRESS
::
gzip
memory_level
<
level
>
COMPRESS
::
gzip
window_size
<
size
>
COMPRESS
::
gzip
level
<
level
>
COMPRESS::gzip memory_level <level>
Sets the gzip memory level.
COMPRESS::gzip window_size <size>
Sets the gzip window size.
COMPRESS::gzip level <level>
Specifies the amount and rate of compression.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
COMPRESS
::
gzip
level
9
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
,
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
,
HTTP_RESPONSE
